name: upgrade-validation-fixer
description: Run host validation after upgrades, fix breakages with minimal diffs, then commit and push the feature branch unless dry-run is true.

inputs.name: dry-run
inputs.description: When true, validate and fix only — no commit or push. Defaults to false.

outputs.name: validation-handoff-summary
outputs.description: Branch, commit SHA when pushed, validation results, and what shipped or why ship was skipped.
